problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable f on ℝᵈ. Its gradient is L-Lipschitz, its infimum f★ is finite, and f(x₀)−f★ ≤ Δ. The class permits nonconvex objectives.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: At call k, the algorithm chooses x and receives only g(x,Zₖ) from one stationary Markov trajectory. Each call consumes one trajectory position, including calls whose replies are discarded. The parameters d, L, Δ, σ, τ, ε and x₀ are public. The objective f, response map g, transition kernel κ, stationary law π and chain states are hidden. The algorithm may randomize and choose queries adaptively.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/AverageMixingMarkovSmoothNonconvex.lean, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.Query, spec.Reply and spec.admissible. LongTails/Template.lean, Algorithm, _run and Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: markov_dependence
distinctive_assumptions.details: The real-valued chain starts in its invariant law π. For every integer t ≥ 0, the stationary average of the total variation distance satisfies ∫ ‖κᵗ(z,·)−π‖TV π(dz) ≤ 2 exp(−t/τ), with τ ≥ 1.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every fixed x, Eπ[g(x,Z)] = ∇f(x) and Eπ[‖g(x,Z)−∇f(x)‖²] ≤ σ². Both moment conditions use the stationary marginal law, so conditional unbiasedness at adaptive queries is not required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The geometry is Euclidean. The valid regime requires L > 0, ε > 0, 2²⁶ ε² ≤ LΔ, 2¹⁶ ε ≤ σ and d ≥ 2⁴⁰(1 + LΔ/ε²)⁴(1 + τ(σ/ε)² log(σ/ε)).

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The algorithm returns a measurable point X in ℝᵈ. The criterion uses the first power of ‖∇f(X)‖ at that output. X may be any point computed from the algorithm state.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: ‖∇f(X)‖ must be integrable and E[‖∇f(X)‖] ≤ ε under the product law of the algorithm seed and the Markov trajectory, with a fixed oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The oracle combines stationary-average total variation mixing with a variance bound under the stationary law. The dimension threshold also depends explicitly on the initial gap, noise level, mixing parameter and target accuracy.
